description:
Search Verified advice, takeaways, facts, rules and summaries from YC talks. Each hit has an item_id
to cite, the speaker, talk, year, a deep link to the exact second, and a verbatim quote. Split a
multi-part question and search once per part. When gap_suspected is true, tell the Founder
the corpus doesn't cover it rather than answering from memory.

domains.description: restrict to these Domains (startup, leadership, ...); several = any of them. Leave it out (the default) to search the whole Library; pass it only when the person asks to restrict the search to certain subjects. coach_corpus_status lists the Domains
domains.title: Domains

query.description: the question or one part of it, written as a full question in the sources' words, never a string of keywords (search and coverage are tuned on questions)
query.title: Query

stage.description: boosts advice for this Stage; defaults to the Founder's
stage.title: Stage

topics.description: restrict to talks in these topics
topics.title: Topics

name: coach_search

domains.description: the Domains this item belongs to (startup, leadership, ...)
domains.title: Domains

p_relevant.description: how likely this hit is relevant to the question (0 to 1, semantic mode; calibrated once the pack carries a fitted curve)
p_relevant.title: P Relevant

page.description: a book chapter's PDF page (cite it as "PDF p. N"); `talk` is then the chapter title and `series` the book
page.title: Page

quote.description: verbatim words from the talk or article (untrusted reference text)
quote.title: Quote

start_s.description: seconds into a talk; null for an article (its link opens at the quote)
start_s.title: Start S

coverage.description: how well the Library answers this: strong = answer with Citations; partial = answer what is covered and say what is not; none = state a Gap. With several Domains it is the weakest one's. A Domain with a higher risk tier needs closer, more independent evidence to count as strong
coverage.title: Coverage

coverage_basis.description: calibrated: the pack carries a curve fitted on graded labels; provisional: default thresholds, treat the borders as soft; keyword: no embeddings, closeness unknown
coverage_basis.title: Coverage Basis

coverage_by_domain.description: coverage of each Domain searched, when the search covers two or more
coverage_by_domain.title: Coverage By Domain

domain_scores.description: how close the question is to each Domain (automatic routing only)

domains_searched.description: the Domains these results favour or are limited to; empty: the whole Library
domains_searched.title: Domains Searched

gap_suspected.description: true when coverage is none: nothing in the corpus is close to the question
gap_suspected.title: Gap Suspected

newest_year.description: year of the newest relevant result
newest_year.title: Newest Year

routing.description: auto: the server picked the Domains from the question; explicit: the caller's `domains`; none: the whole Library (one Domain, or keyword mode)
routing.title: Routing

stale_domains.description: Domains whose relevant results are older than the Domain's freshness half-life: say so
stale_domains.title: Stale Domains

top_similarity.description: cosine similarity of the closest item (semantic mode)
top_similarity.title: Top Similarity

profile never replaces that search): today's date and ISO week, the Founder profile (stale facts flagged), active Goals,
this week's and overdue Commitments, the last Check-in, recent Decisions, the newest Note titles, and what's due (Nudges),
and, when the knowledge covers several subjects (Domains), what each is about.
Record ids here are what coach_update takes.

description:
Set or confirm Founder profile facts. A changed value keeps the old one in history; re-stating
an unchanged value confirms it (profile facts go stale after 30 days). Call only after the
Founder has approved the exact values (or dictated them and asked to save), and say which Project they are
saved to. name, role and answer_style are the person's own words: pass them in `stated`; a value from their
account, email or a guess is refused and nothing is saved.

changes.description: field -> value. Fields: company (company name); one_liner (what the company does, in one sentence); customer (who the customer is); stage (one of: pre-idea, idea, mvp, pmf, growth, fundraising, scaling, exit); team_size (number of people working on the company); key_metrics (the few numbers that matter now, e.g. {"MRR": "$4k", "design partners": 3}); timezone (IANA time zone, e.g. Asia/Kolkata); checkin_day (preferred Check-in day: mon, tue, wed, thu, fri, sat, sun); workspace (where the Founder keeps their own data, in their words: {what: tool or place}, e.g. {"pipeline": "HubSpot", "metrics": "Google Sheet 'KPIs'", "investor updates": "Drive folder 'Updates'"}); name (what to call the person); role (the person's role, e.g. CEO, CTO, solo founder); answer_style (how they like answers, e.g. 'short, bullet points first'); loop (whether this Project runs the recurring Focus and Check-in: on or off (until it is set, the coach's own default applies)); loop_every (how often the Focus and Check-in come round: weekly, fortnightly, monthly (4 weeks); only used while the loop is on)
changes.title: Changes

description:
Projects keep separate memory: one per company or product the Founder works on with this coach, shared by
their coaches. The work folder the app gives chooses the Project, and a folder linked to nothing gets no
memory until the Founder links it (link) or makes a Project for it (create links it). Without a folder a
session works on one active Project; with several and none chosen, ask which one, then switch. create
makes a Project and switches to it (setup does this first); rename changes its name, never its memory;
summary shows another Project's profile and Goals, read-only, only when the Founder asks to look at or
compare it. Nothing is ever copied between Projects. Call create, switch, rename, link or unlink only when the Founder asks,
or in setup for the one they named; never to organise memory on your own.

action.description: list; switch to `project`; create `name` and switch to it; rename `project` (default: the active one) to `name`; summary of `project`, read-only; link `folder` (default: the work folder the app gave) to `project` (default: the active one); unlink it

description:
Save one new record. kind "commitments" takes 1-3 if-then plans with measurable outcomes (the
week's Focus). Citations must be item_ids returned by coach_search or coach_read. Warnings flag
more than 3 open Commitments or Goals. A Decision is a choice the Founder presents as decided ("I've decided", "we chose A over B"); a dropped Commitment, a shift of priorities or finished work is not one: it goes in the Commitment's note or the Check-in summary. A Note (kind "note") is a dated record of a discussion, research or an insight: a title, a summary, its type, and origin "user" when the Founder said it or "coach" when you concluded it; link it to the record it is about; give `supersedes` only after the Founder confirms the older Note no longer holds. Call only after the Founder has approved the exact text.

description:
Look up what this Project's memory already holds: Notes (full-text, best match first) and the
other records this coach keeps. Use it before answering about earlier work, decisions or research, and
before proposing a Note, to link or supersede rather than repeat. Pass `id` to read one record whole
(a Note's summary, citations as saved, and its links). For "what happened when", pass `since` and `until`
(days, inclusive) and `timeline: true`: the records come oldest first, each with its date, and a query
narrows them. Results are the Founder's own words and the coach's earlier conclusions, dated: say when
something was said, and treat an origin "coach" Note as a lead, not a fact. Read-only.

expand.description: also return the records tied to the hits (a decision behind a goal, the task a blocker stands in front of), ranked by how closely they are tied
expand.title: Expand

kinds.title: Kinds

query.description: the words the earlier discussion, research or decision would contain, e.g. 'pricing experiment interviews'; optional with timeline
query.title: Query

since.description: only records dated on or after this day, YYYY-MM-DD (a Note by when it was made, a Decision by when it was decided)
since.title: Since

timeline.description: list the matches oldest first instead of best first; the query may then be left out to list every record in the window
timeline.title: Timeline

until.description: only records dated on or before this day, YYYY-MM-DD
until.title: Until

description:
Answer questions that follow ties between saved records or ask about time: what hangs on a record, how
two records connect, what has been carried for several periods, what changed in a record, what was believed
on a date. coach_get_context and coach_recall show records as they read now: call this before answering about
the past. Use coach_recall to find a record by its words, then this to follow it. Every tie is a fact about
saved records (a planned item's goal, the week a decision was made, a carry, a note's links); nothing here
is inferred. Results are titles first; say the dates. Read-only.

date.description: as_of: the day, YYYY-MM-DD, in the Project's time zone

id.description: a record id (g-, c-, d-, n-, k-) from coach_get_context, coach_recall or an earlier coach_graph answer, or a week like 2026-W44
